CREATE TABLE high_risk_transactions AS
SELECT 
    ra.riskregistry,
    ra.moneyrisk,
    ra.txchainlen,
    ra.wallbalusd,
    ra.wallturnrt,
    ra.txvel,
    ra.idverifyscore,
    (
        (t.payamtusd / 1000) * 
        (t.txfinishhrs / 24) * 
        (1 + (t.escrowhrs / 100)) * 
        (1 - (m.esccomprate / 100))
    ) AS tas,
    (
        (ra.txchainlen * 10) + 
        (ra.linkedtxcount * 5) + 
        (ra.fraudprob * 100) - 
        (ra.profilecomplete * 0.5) - 
        (ra.idverifyscore * 0.5)
    ) AS tcr,
    (
        (COUNT(t.txregistry) OVER (PARTITION BY t.buyref)) / 
        (MAX(t.eventstamp) OVER (PARTITION BY t.buyref) - 
        MIN(t.eventstamp) OVER (PARTITION BY t.buyref))
    ) * (
        t.payamtusd / 500
    ) * (
        1 + (
            CASE t.paymethod
                WHEN 'Crypto_A' THEN 1
                WHEN 'Crypto_B' THEN 3
                WHEN 'Crypto_C' THEN 2
                WHEN 'Token' THEN 2
                ELSE 0
            END * 0.1
        )
    ) AS tvm
FROM 
    riskanalysis ra
JOIN 
    transactions t ON ra.txref = t.txregistry
JOIN 
    markets m ON t.mktref = m.mktregistry
WHERE 
    ra.moneyrisk = 'High';

CREATE TABLE high_risk_transactions AS
SELECT 
    ra.riskregistry,
    ra.moneyrisk,
    ra.txchainlen,
    ra.wallbalusd,
    ra.wallturnrt,
    ra.txvel,
    ra.idverifyscore,
    (
        (t.payamtusd / 1000) * 
        (t.txfinishhrs / 24) * 
        (1 + (t.escrowhrs / 100)) * 
        (1 - (m.esccomprate / 100))
    ) AS tas,
    (
        (ra.txchainlen * 10) + 
        (ra.linkedtxcount * 5) + 
        (ra.fraudprob * 100) - 
        (ra.profilecomplete * 0.5) - 
        (ra.idverifyscore * 0.5)
    ) AS tcr,
    (
        (COUNT(t.txregistry) OVER (PARTITION BY t.buyref)) / 
        (MAX(t.eventstamp) OVER (PARTITION BY t.buyref) - 
        MIN(t.eventstamp) OVER (PARTITION BY t.buyref))
    ) * (
        t.payamtusd / 500
    ) * (
        1 + (
            CASE t.paymethod
                WHEN 'Crypto_A' THEN 1
                WHEN 'Crypto_B' THEN 3
                WHEN 'Crypto_C' THEN 2
                WHEN 'Token' THEN 2
                ELSE 0
            END * 0.1
        )
    ) AS tvm
FROM 
    riskanalysis ra
JOIN 
    transactions t ON ra.txref = t.txregistry
JOIN 
    markets m ON t.mktref = m.mktregistry
WHERE 
    ra.moneyrisk = 'High';
